day_shape: 91 items: US DOJ indictment on IRGC-linked plot against RAF Fairford, Treasury Secretary Bessent relocated to military base over Iran threats, Qatar claims two-week US-Iran diplomatic window, heavy Khamenei Fatimiyeh mourning cycle, nothing from UK Parliament or IAEA.

threads.label: IRGC plots against US-UK targets
threads.summary: A US indictment unsealed Tuesday alleged an Iran-backed operative coordinated a plot to attack RAF Fairford from a New York jail using coded family messages, while the FBI added an IRGC member accused in the Bolton assassination plot to its Most Wanted Terrorists list. The US Treasury confirmed Secretary Scott Bessent had relocated from his Washington home to a military base following Iranian threats against his life.

threads.label: Qatar-brokered US-Iran diplomatic window
threads.summary: Qatari PM Al Thani told G7 foreign ministers Doha had secured "at least two weeks" to pursue a US-Iran deal and avert renewed US strikes, per diplomatic sources cited by the Jerusalem Post. Marco Rubio said sanctions and a naval blockade were pressuring Tehran enough to remove the need for major combat, while Iran International reported state TV signalling cautious openness to talks and former Mossad research chief Sima Shine calling a deal more likely, with enrichment the main obstacle.

threads.label: US blockade and economic pressure on Iran
threads.summary: Iran International reported on the sustainability of Trump's Iran naval blockade in the Persian Gulf and warnings from an Iranian economist that prolonged US pressure risks eroding the economy without a sudden collapse. The Jerusalem Post reported tanker attacks continuing in the Strait of Hormuz even as oil prices hit two-month lows, while Khamenei adviser Makhber posted that "any complicity in hostile blockade against Iran is an act of war."

threads.label: Fatimiyeh mourning cycle at Zeynabiyeh
threads.summary: Khamenei's office published an extended run of audio, video and photo posts from the first night of Fatimiyeh 1405 mourning ceremonies hosted by the Supreme Leader at Zeynabiyeh, featuring elegies by Hajj Mansoor Arzehei and Abbas Haidarzadeh and a speech by Hojjat al-Islam Mehdi Eslani. IRIB and Defa Press also carried coverage of the ceremonies alongside two Khamenei condolence messages for artist Kourosh Zarei and writer Mansoor Anouri.

threads.label: Iranian defence messaging and claims
threads.summary: IRIB and Defa Press carried statements from Defence Ministry spokesman General Talaiee-nik that adversaries must "accept Iran's rightful demands or surrender," Judiciary head Larijani praising the late "Father of Iran's Missiles" Tehrani Moghaddam, and coverage claiming global media acknowledgement of a newly revealed IRGC missile city. Iran International reported Iran designated Argentina's navy and air force as terrorist organisations under a 2019 reciprocity law after Buenos Aires designated the IRGC.

threads.label: Gaza winter conditions and diplomacy
threads.summary: UK Foreign Secretary Ed Miliband posted a video demanding Israel act on Gaza's deteriorating humanitarian situation after winter flooding destroyed tents, and Netanyahu's office said Israel had facilitated a winterization plan with international partners following Board of Peace and UNICEF criticism. Defa Press carried UN Special Rapporteur Francesca Albanese's call for Israel to open all Gaza crossings, while IRIB reported two Palestinians killed in a strike on a Sheikh Radwan tent camp.

threads.label: Iran domestic strain and institutional moves
threads.summary: Iran International reported workers selling kidneys, liver tissue and bone marrow to repay debts per ILNA, and students attending unheated classrooms as the government warned of gas shortages; UN OCHA's GIEWS brief noted low reservoir levels for 2027 winter cereal planting and persistent cereal price inflation. Iran International also reported parliament weighing a proposal to allow a non-cleric Intelligence Minister and give the Supreme Leader direct appointment powers over two new ministry bodies.

The deputy commander of the Sepah of the Prophet Muhammad announced the planting of one million saplings in Tehran over four years and said: in different sections, in memory of the martyrs of the second and third imposed wars, particularly the martyrs of the Naveship Dena and the martyrs of Shajarat Tayyebah School in Minab, a number of saplings will be planted. Planting of 313,000 saplings will continue until the end of the year; we also plan to plant up to one million saplings throughout Tehran. Similarly, a large number of saplings will be planted in honour of the prominent martyrs of the third imposed war; each of these trees is tagged and will be registered in a system for future tracking.

events.title_en: German army's failure in helicopter fleet modernisation
events.summary_en: German army's failure in helicopter fleet modernisation. Germany's army programme to modernize its helicopter fleet faces multiple technical problems that will prevent the modernization of this fleet within the previously set timeframe. Germany signed a contract in 2023 for the purchase of 62 H145M helicopters from Airbus Helicopters and in 2025 activated the option to purchase 20 additional helicopters of this type. Twenty-four of these helicopters were to be equipped with anti-armour capabilities to meet some of the German army's combat needs during the period before the introduction of the replacement Tiger helicopters.

events.title_en: Condolence message from the Supreme Leader following the death of committed and revolutionary artist Kourosh Zarei
events.summary_en: Condolence message from the Supreme Leader following the death of committed and revolutionary artist Kourosh Zarei. Ayatollah Seyed Mujtaba Hosseini Khamenei, Supreme Leader of the Islamic Revolution, in a message expressed condolences on the death of committed and revolutionary artist Kourosh Zarei. The text of the Supreme Leader's message is as follows: In the name of God, the Most Merciful. The death of Mr Kourosh Zarei, a committed and revolutionary artist of the country, is a cause of regret. The tireless activities of that deceased in developing the performing arts in cities and less-developed areas of the country and his steadfastness in the values of the Islamic revolution were admirable. While expressing my condolences to his family and the country's artistic community, I pray to Almighty God.

The text of the Supreme Leader's message is as follows: In the name of God, the Most Merciful. The death of Mr Mansoor Anouri, a committed and revolutionary writer, was a cause of regret. events.title: An Israeli civilian illegally crossed the border into Lebanon a short while ago, near the Rosh Hanikra Crossing, the military says. The military says the man was located by United Nations forces near the border and handed over to IDF troops, who escorted him back to Israeli territory. The man was then handed over to the police for further questioning. Crossing the border illegally is punishable by up to four years in jail. The IDF says the incident is under further investigation.

events.title: The price Iranians paid for 47 years of revolutionary promises
events.summary: Nearly 47 years after Iran's 1979 revolution, a former football chief has asked what Iranians got for its promises, pointing to officials’ children living abroad, oil wealth that never reached wages and a state that answered protests with bullets.

events.title: Seven in 10 Americans want new Congress to end Iran war - Reuters/Ipsos poll
events.summary: Seventy-one percent of Americans want the new Democratic-led Congress to pass a law ending the war with Iran, including half of Republicans, a Reuters/Ipsos poll found, a week after midterm elections that handed Democrats their largest majorities since at least 2008.

events.title: Rubio tells G7 the US will keep imposing ‘devastating’ costs on Iran
events.summary: Secretary of State Marco Rubio told G7 foreign ministers in Paris on Tuesday that the United States would keep imposing devastating economic costs on Iran and had options beyond resuming the war or accepting Tehran’s demands, Reuters reported, citing four G7 diplomats.

events.title: Hegseth says he’d repeat Iran strikes, warns US remains ‘locked and loaded’
